closed_reason: Added --project flag to ticker run command. Modified cmd/ticker/main.go to add flag parsing, project filtering in autoSelectEpics, and warning when epic project doesn't match. Added ListReadyEpicsWithProject to ticks client with local filtering fallback for tk CLI compatibility. Added Project field to Epic type.
description:
Add --project flag to ticker run command:
- ticker run --project "2026-01-14-6453-auth"
- ticker run --auto --project "..."
- ticker run <epic-id> --project "..." (validate epic matches)

Behavior:
- Filter epics/tasks to only those matching project
- With --auto, only consider epics with matching project
- With explicit epic ID, warn if epic has different project
